title: Vintage Vegas Sights & Sounds
includes: Round trip transportation to/from Las Vegas hotels
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: There is no better way to explore Las Vegas than from an open-air Jeep Wrangler with a knowledgeable and entertaining guide. From Wedding Chapel Row to the "Welcome to Fabulous Las Vegas" sign, take an adventure down the famous Las Vegas Boulevard on a guided daytime tour with insider knowledge of how a small town transformed into an international destination. Drive by famous hotels that were an integral part of Las Vegas history. Finish off the tour with a 30 minute ride 550 feet in the air for incredible views on the High Roller, the world's largest observation wheel. Ticket included in tour price ($27 value)
